summary: Oversized leaf: the spec bundles three independently testable, independently shippable behaviors - (1) replacing obvious debug geometry in all six critical-path areas (world content data, per-area before/after walk), (2) the six section 48 juice effects implemented on the section 35 toolbox (particles, light sway, depth-record HUD cue, distant-motion nudge, parting schools), and (3) section 16 camera feel (low-frequency shake path with the WI-06g presentation flag plus widescreen composition). The behavior field itself lists three clauses and the AC-art-geometry criterion merges two different deliverables. Four named responsibilities change (content data, effects toolbox, shake path, widescreen layout), over the three limit; 'rendering and materials' folds effects, camera and composition into one umbrella. What is sound and must be preserved on the children: depends_on WI-06a/b/c, AC-art-geometry and AC-art-palettes carried verbatim, the cross-band contrast walk named to exactly one final proof owner, defect-report routing for exposed simulation gaps, and the spoiler rule. Useful split boundary (promote to a story, children WI-06d-a/b/c, all inheriting depends_on WI-06a/b/c): WI-06d-a geometry replacement in all critical-path areas (world content data; final proof owner of the AC-art-geometry geometry part); WI-06d-b the six section 48 juice effects (rendering and materials; final proof owner of the AC-art-geometry juice part and of the AC-art-palettes cross-band walk, whose particle-profile factor depends on per-band juice particles); WI-06d-c section 16 shake rules and widescreen behavior (camera). Gap the revision must close: no parent criterion covers shake or widescreen, so WI-06d-c needs child-local criteria; the existing WI-06g dependency on WI-06d then means all three leaves. Handoff, non-goals and evidence per behavior are otherwise fresh-session ready.
